music.name: Polo & Pan, Dabeull
music.why: Polo & Pan's Americas Tour touches down for a rare outdoor block-party format with a full day-to-night lineup.
music.summary: French duo Polo & Pan headline a seven-hour open-air block party at The Midway with support from Dabeull and a stacked local lineup, followed by an after-party at neighboring 888 Garage.

music.summary: Comedy collective HellaFunny takes over Moe Greens cannabis lounge for a free, RSVP stand-up show with a rotating 4-5 comic lineup drawn from SF Sketchfest, Cobb's and the Punchline.

music.name: Reclaimed Riffs: A Punk Rock Yard Party (SF)

music.summary: Resort-O-Rama returns to Santa Rosa's Flamingo Resort for a four-day celebration of mid-century modern design and culture, with Saturday packed with seminars, a marketplace, wine tastings, a Charles Phoenix slideshow and the 'Vintage Space-O-Rama Atomic A-Go-Go!' nightclub party into the early morning.

music.name: Secret Psychedelica: Libra 2026

music.summary: DNA Lounge's long-running monthly zodiac party marks the Libra sign with psytrance in one room and house/techno in the other, part of a series that has run continuously at the venue since the early 2000s.

music.summary: A Love and Deepspace-themed fan market at KOHO in SF Japantown, celebrating the game's character birthdays with an artist alley, cosplay gathering, photobooth, and stamp rally.

music.name: Tinlicker

music.summary: Dutch melodic-house/progressive duo Tinlicker bring their live trio show to The Midway in Dogpatch, blending DJ sets with live instrumentation from their 'Cold Enough For Snow' era.

music.name: Twin Diplomacy
music.why: A fast-rising house duo with 200M+ streams and support from John Summit and Dom Dolla, at an intimate South Bay club.
music.summary: Miami twin-brother duo Twin Diplomacy bring their melodic and tech-house sound to Pure Nightclub's Sunnyvale dance floor.

music.name: The Egyptian Lover, Love Supreme
music.why: 40 years of old-school electro/freestyle from a genre originator, on a rare Sunday night during the Indigenous Peoples' Day long weekend
music.summary: Electro-rap pioneer The Egyptian Lover headlines DNA Lounge's Main Room, backed by San Francisco's Love Supreme Sound System spinning electro, freestyle, hip hop, dancehall and global bass.

music.summary: Recurring phone-free after-hours clubbing night at NYX's San Bruno Ave venue, running deep into the morning with a surprise guest DJ.

music.name: SALTED Day Party with Sandy Rivera & John Morales
SALTED on the Terrace with Sandy Rivera & John Morales
music.why: House royalty Sandy Rivera and disco-edit legend John Morales headline the season-closing outdoor terrace party.
music.summary: Brothers & Sisters' SALTED day party returns to The Midway's outdoor terrace for its final open-air session of the year, headlined by Sandy Rivera (Kings of Tomorrow / Defected) and NYC remix veteran John Morales, with residents Miguel Migs, Julius Papp and Franky Boissy.

music.name: Salted w/ Sandy Rivera
music.why: Legendary KOT/Defected house DJ Sandy Rivera headlines alongside NYC remix veteran John Morales (Glitterbox), with local residents Miguel Migs, Julius Papp, and B&S founder Franky Boissy rounding out the outdoor patio lineup.
music.summary: Brothers & Sisters bring Salted back to the Midway patio for their final open-air session of the year, an afternoon-into-evening house and disco day party.

sports.name: ArtWalk Livermore: 200+ Artists + New Chalk Art Fest (Downtown Livermore)
sports.why: 200+ artists fill downtown Livermore's sidewalks and plazas, plus a new live chalk art festival
sports.summary: ArtWalk is the Tri-Valley's premiere one-day art festival, with over 200 artists showing work across downtown Livermore's sidewalks, plazas, parks and galleries. 2026 adds Chalk the Walk, a live chalk art festival in front of the Bankhead Theater, plus a high-school art display and a Portrait Art Paint Off.

sports.name: Ruth Anderson Memorial Endurance Run
sports.address: 100 Lake Merced Blvd & Sunset Blvd, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: A Bay Area ultrarunning tradition with a scenic lakeside loop course and a full aid station every lap.
sports.summary: Looped ultramarathon around Lake Merced offering marathon, 50K, and 50-mile distances on a certified 4.5-mile paved/dirt-shoulder loop, honoring pioneering ultrarunner Ruth Anderson.

sports.name: San Jose Sharks vs. Edmonton Oilers
sports.address: 525 W Santa Clara St, San Jose, CA 95113
sports.why: Season-opening-week matchup against reigning Western Conference contender Edmonton at SAP Center
sports.summary: The San Jose Sharks host the Edmonton Oilers at SAP Center in a Saturday afternoon regular-season matchup, with a Sharks x PWHL San Jose tee giveaway for fans.

sports.name: SF’s “Drunk Theatre” Halloween Special: Nightmare on Valencia St. (Oct. 10)
sports.why: Drunk Theatre is a recurring 1st/3rd-Saturday improv-comedy show at Eclectic Box; this Halloween edition adds special-effects monster makeup and surprise reveals to the usual drunk-improv format.

sports.name: Windmill 10K
sports.venue: Golden Gate Park (Queen Wilhelmina Windmill, JFK Drive)
sports.address: JFK Drive & Great Highway, San Francisco, CA 94121
sports.why: A scenic park out-and-back past the historic Dutch windmill, with free parking and finisher ribbons.
sports.summary: An out-and-back 10K along JFK Drive in Golden Gate Park, starting and finishing near the Queen Wilhelmina (Dutch) Windmill, with a gradual uphill-to-flat first half and downhill-to-flat second half.
